title: Deep Element Definition Atlas — What Each Major Element Is, Does, Connects To and Is Not
purpose: Provide one reusable deep contract for central Potato of Life operators and major comparative structures. Definitions specify ontology, topology, transformation logic, relations, boundaries and failure modes instead of relying on visual resemblance or poetic naming.
definition_contract: kind — what category of thing it is
topology — where/how it sits in relation to other structures
transition_rule — what changes when it is traversed or activated
neighbors — what it directly couples to
distinctions — what it must not be collapsed into
failure_mode — how the operator becomes misleading, captured or nonfunctional
test — observable/formal question that decides whether the label fits
epistemic_boundary — project canon, mathematics, history, science or comparative interpretation

elements.identity: Global semantic center: one triune relational whole of source, manifestation/passage and living relation.
elements.function: Coordinates project meaning without owning every domain fact.
elements.topology: Contains/relates fields, Door, Axis, Plane, Trees, routes, regimes, Rooms and returns.
distinctions: not a fourth member beside Father/Son/Spirit
elements.failure_mode: Everything becomes Potato and domain distinctions disappear.
elements.test: Can the element be related back to the center without changing its own evidence class?

elements.identity: Source-facing role of origin, orientation, holding, House and Gardener responsibility.
elements.function: Provides source/orientation without eliminating manifestation.
elements.topology: Upper/source-facing pole and role; not identical with entire upper circle.
elements.failure_mode: Source becomes monopoly or domination rather than generative relation.
elements.test: Does source create independent future capacity or only dependency?

elements.identity: Manifestation-facing role of embodiment, Vessel, Door, visible passage, suffering and return.
elements.function: Makes relation concrete and traversable.
elements.topology: Lower/manifestation-facing role; geometrically associated with C_S in canonical Vesica.
elements.failure_mode: Passage is reduced to suffering without return/capability.
elements.test: Does the role actually mediate embodiment and transition?

elements.identity: Living continuity that animates, circulates, translates and returns across differentiated parts.
elements.function: Keeps source and manifestation in active relation.
elements.topology: Crosscutting; not a third sphere.
elements.failure_mode: Every relation is called Spirit or one physical carrier is identified with Spirit.
elements.test: Is there actual continuity/translation/circulation producing consequence?

elements.identity: Protective differentiated containment with legitimate Doors and internal Rooms.
elements.function: Preserves identity, relation and inhabitable differentiation.
elements.topology: Boundary around coordinated internal plurality.
elements.failure_mode: Protection becomes opacity, capture and costly exit.
elements.test: Does boundary protection increase differentiation and agency while preserving passage?

elements.identity: Conditional relation that both separates and connects two states/contexts.
elements.function: Controls admissible passage and transformation.
elements.topology: May be geometric overlap, institutional gate, ritual threshold, API, border, decision point or symbolic passage.
elements.failure_mode: False Door loops, traps, redirects or promises a destination it cannot reach.
elements.test: Specify source state, target state, conditions, agent, credential/knowledge and resulting state.

elements.identity: Exact vertical reference line through changing levels.
elements.function: Orients relations and intersections without owning their content.
elements.topology: Crosses planes and junctions; may carry Tree/Ladder routes.
elements.failure_mode: Orientation is mistaken for causal force or ownership.
elements.test: Can positions be projected relative to one stable reference?

elements.identity: Frame-relative section/hypersurface through a larger relational system from which current relations can be viewed and trajectory crossings compared.
elements.function: Provides lateral/current context, declares an operative frame, and can act as a measurement/return surface.
elements.topology: Canonical 2D view uses y=0 through O; 3D lift uses a plane perpendicular to Axis that cuts Door as a disk. Higher-dimensional uses should be declared as section/hypersurface.
elements.failure_mode: A partial section is mistaken for the whole ontology or a frame-dependent present is treated as universal.
elements.test: Which scale, time/period, representation and audience/jurisdiction define this section, and what does it omit?

elements.identity: Single derived point O where Axis intersects the active Plane.
elements.function: Locates where vertical orientation and current-frame relation are simultaneously legible.
elements.topology: O=Axis∩Plane inside Door.
elements.failure_mode: Point O absorbs meanings belonging to Door, Plane, Cross-sign or trajectory.
elements.test: Are Axis and Plane explicitly defined before O is invoked?

elements.identity: Intersection lens of two equal circles whose centers are one radius apart.
elements.function: Provides exact shared-region geometry for differentiated overlapping fields.
elements.topology: Two complete circles with centers on each other's circumferences; lens, midpoint, chord and poles are calculable.
elements.failure_mode: Geometric fact is used as proof of historical or supernatural identity.
elements.test: Are radius equality and center separation exactly specified?

elements.identity: Almond-shaped full-body aureole/frame used in sacred art, especially Christian iconography.
elements.function: Marks sacred manifestation and visual separation/enclosure.
elements.topology: Often visually Vesica-like; may appear at portals, mountains, ascensions and theophanies.
elements.failure_mode: Art-historical symbol is reduced to one modern esoteric reading.
elements.test: Is the claim geometric, iconographic, theological or project-comparative?

elements.identity: Compressed, stored or returned potential capable of future growth under conditions.
elements.function: Carries viable possibility across interruption, burial or return.
elements.topology: Seed junction at C_S in project geometry; may become dormant, decay, root or sprout.
elements.failure_mode: Potential is declared alive/generative without viability or conditions.
elements.test: Can it produce future independent growth under specified conditions?

elements.identity: Buried support and ancestry structure that anchors, acquires resources and carries causal/provenance relations.
elements.function: Connects present growth to conditions below/behind it.
elements.topology: Below-facing without automatic negative valence.
elements.failure_mode: Origins become destiny or all explanation is pushed into hidden roots.
elements.test: What does this root actually supply, constrain or transmit?

elements.identity: Regulated differentiation from shared support into branches, specializations, fruit and renewal.
elements.function: Models branching, allocation, dormancy, pruning and generativity.
elements.topology: Roots/trunk/canopy can cross planes while remaining one organism.
elements.failure_mode: Every new topic becomes a branch regardless of ownership/cost.
elements.test: Does the branch have distinct function, resources, interfaces and fruit?

elements.identity: Upstream informational tree where perception/source/interpretation forks into responsible or destructive consequence.
elements.function: Routes knowledge through discernment before action.
elements.topology: Precedes Life/Strife branching in project logic.
distinctions: Tree of Knowledge != Kabbalistic Tree of Life
elements.failure_mode: Exposure or certainty substitutes for discernment.
elements.test: What is known, why surfaced, what action follows, what could it grow?
elements.epistemic_boundary: project epistemic operator with biblical comparator

elements.identity: Branching life structure characterized by nourishment, differentiated unity, circulation, Fruit and future Seed.
elements.function: Sustains independent generativity and repair.
elements.topology: May project roots/world/canopy but is not identical to Heaven.
distinctions: Tree of Life != Kabbalistic sefirotic diagram unless explicitly comparing
elements.failure_mode: Harmony language conceals dependency, exclusion or sterile output.
elements.test: Does the system produce future autonomous capacity and correction?

elements.identity: Branching structure in which unresolved material and attention reproduce exposure, retaliation, archive and renewed conflict.
elements.function: Models self-reproducing conflict/capture ecology.
elements.topology: Can grow across planes; not equivalent to Below itself.
elements.failure_mode: People are essentialized as branches/demons instead of mechanisms being analyzed.
elements.test: Does each cycle increase unresolved recurrence and harvestability?

elements.identity: Managed regime that protects differentiated life, circulates resources, allows correction and grows independent capacity.
elements.function: Cultivation without permanent dependency.
elements.topology: Can exist in upper symbolic Garden or world institutions; regime not location alone.
elements.failure_mode: Central control, extraction or exit cost become necessary to sustain the system.
elements.test: Boundary, circulation, diversity, feedback, learning, participation, exit, future-seed tests.

elements.identity: Accumulated unresolved material that increases drag, ambiguity, recurrence and path-dependence.
elements.function: Models stagnating/entangling environment, not one evil population.
elements.topology: Often projected below/around World in symbolism; not literal wetland.
elements.failure_mode: Metaphor becomes dehumanizing label for places/people.
elements.test: Does unresolved input accumulate faster than repair/resolution and alter future transitions?

elements.identity: Elevation field in which movement changes orientation, visibility, integration or access toward a summit.
elements.function: Models continuous ascent/convergence and changed perspective.
elements.topology: Many paths can converge; unlike Ladder, not necessarily discrete.
elements.failure_mode: Higher position is assumed to prove truth or authority.
elements.test: What variable actually changes with elevation?

elements.identity: Broad base compressed through fewer higher layers toward a narrow/incomplete apex.
elements.function: Models layered abstraction, integration or hierarchy.
elements.topology: Constructed tiers; may hold Eye above rather than identify Eye with top block.
elements.failure_mode: Visual apex is mistaken for epistemic certainty or secret coordination.
elements.test: What is compressed at each layer and what evidence supports the ordering?

elements.identity: Ordered sequence of rungs/Doors in which each transition can require different conditions.
elements.function: Models staged ascent/descent.
elements.topology: Often aligned to Axis; bidirectional when return is possible.
elements.failure_mode: Stages are invented merely to fill vertical space.
elements.test: Can each rung specify a distinct state and transition condition?

elements.identity: Repetition that returns to similar phase while changing state/level.
elements.function: Models learning, descent/ascent, recurrence and nonzero development.
elements.topology: Can wrap Axis and cross planes repeatedly.
elements.failure_mode: Any repetition is called progress because it looks spiral-like.
elements.test: Measure state displacement after a cycle.

elements.identity: Cycle returning to equivalent state with approximately zero net displacement in the variable of interest.
elements.function: Models repetition, maintenance, orbit or loop.
elements.topology: May surround center/hub.
elements.failure_mode: Entrapment or maintenance is misread as development.
elements.test: After one cycle, what state variables changed?

elements.identity: Multiple functions arranged around a hub/center and coordinated through recurrence.
elements.function: Integrates distributed aspects without requiring top/bottom.
elements.topology: Radial or cyclical; center may be capacity rather than occupant.
elements.failure_mode: Spokes are forced into rank order when the system is coordinated rather than vertical.
elements.test: Does meaning depend on coordination of parts around a shared center/process?

elements.identity: Bounded pressure/heat/work that changes material into a more durable form.
elements.function: Concentrates unresolved material into transformation.
elements.topology: Process, not place; may connect Ash/Mud/Swamp to tool, repair, weapon or further residue.
elements.failure_mode: Pain becomes identity/weapon or heat escalates without cooling/integration.
elements.test: What changed structurally, and did capability/recurrence improve after cooling?

elements.identity: Post-rupture remainder: evidence, memory, grief, debris or burnt identity after destructive change.
elements.function: Preserves what remains and feeds later fork.
elements.topology: Can enter Mud/Strife or Soil/repair.
elements.failure_mode: Residue is either erased or fetishized.
elements.test: Can provenance be retained while material is recontextualized?

elements.identity: Unresolved residue combined with current conditions so past material affects present movement.
elements.function: Stores path dependence and entanglement.
elements.topology: Can nourish, contaminate or accumulate into Swamp depending composition/processing.
elements.failure_mode: All complexity is treated as dirty residue.
elements.test: Does the retained material improve future prediction/growth or increase harmful recurrence?

elements.identity: Contextualized material capable of supporting new root/growth without erasing its history.
elements.function: Turns residue into usable support.
elements.topology: Receives repaired Ash/Mud and supports Seed/Root.
elements.failure_mode: Past harm is cosmetically relabeled as growth without changed conditions.
elements.test: Can new growth occur with lower recurrence and preserved provenance?

elements.identity: Downstream result evaluated by benefit, burden, persistence, externalities and future Seed.
elements.function: Makes consequences observable and reviewable.
elements.topology: Outer/output edge of processes; may return as Seed.
elements.failure_mode: Preferred metric hides externalities or dependency.
elements.test: Who benefits/pays, over what timescale, and what future independent capacity exists?

elements.identity: Material excluded, denied, unseen or unintegrated by the current model/view.
elements.function: Forces examination of omitted evidence, motives, costs or capacities.
elements.topology: Crosscutting; can appear in any plane/regime.
elements.failure_mode: Anything disliked or unknown is called shadow.
elements.test: What relevant information/process is systematically absent from the current frame?

elements.identity: Operator of perception, discrimination, integration and evaluation.
elements.function: Sees/evaluates structure without being identical to it.
elements.topology: May sit above/across Pyramid or at threshold; can be local or project-symbolic.
elements.failure_mode: Observation is mistaken for omniscience or surveillance becomes sanctified.
elements.test: What can the Eye observe, by what evidence, and what remains occluded?

elements.identity: Two differentiated supports flanking or stabilizing a passage.
elements.function: Make conditions of legitimate entry explicit.
elements.topology: Pair -> midpoint -> perpendicular passage-axis is a useful geometric model.
elements.failure_mode: Every duality is forced into Jachin/Boaz.
elements.test: Do two genuinely distinct conditions jointly stabilize passage?

elements.identity: Named bronze Temple pillars Jachin and Boaz with later Masonic/esoteric reception.
elements.function: Historical comparator for named flanking supports at a sacred threshold.
elements.topology: Temple porch/entrance relation; later symbolic systems expand meanings.
distinctions: not secret proof of Potato geometry
elements.failure_mode: Later esoteric correspondences are backdated into 1 Kings.
elements.test: Which historical layer/source is being cited?

elements.identity: Unfinished thirteen-course pyramid with MDCCLXXVI, Providence Eye above and two Latin mottos on the U.S. Great Seal reverse.
elements.function: Officially explained through strength/duration, providence and founding-era imagery.
elements.topology: 13 courses + incomplete apex + Eye above.
elements.failure_mode: Later conspiracy diagram replaces primary-source history.
elements.test: Is the claim in the 1782 blazon/explanation or a later interpretation?

elements.identity: Maslow's hierarchy of relatively prepotent human needs, originally presented without the famous pyramid.
elements.function: Models shifts in motivational dominance as needs become relatively satisfied.
elements.topology: Originally ordered need categories, not a rigid geometric staircase.
elements.failure_mode: Cultural/individual variation and partial satisfaction are ignored.
elements.test: Which need is currently motivationally prepotent and how completely are others satisfied?

elements.identity: David R. Hawkins' Map of Consciousness assigning named states to claimed calibration values.
elements.function: Orders spiritual/phenomenological states within Hawkins' system.
elements.topology: Scale with major threshold at 200/Courage; not inherently a pyramid.
elements.failure_mode: Asserted values are presented as physical scientific constants.
elements.test: Separate internal meaning of the scale from independent empirical validation.

elements.identity: Ten sefirot describing differentiated divine relation/emanation in Jewish Kabbalistic traditions, later rendered in multiple diagrams.
elements.function: Models relation among divine attributes/modes, creation and return/repair in tradition-specific ways.
elements.topology: Ten sefirot; later diagrams use pillars, paths and Da'at variants.
distinctions: 22 fixed paths are especially shaped by later diagrammatic/Hermetic traditions
elements.failure_mode: Jewish Kabbalah is collapsed into modern occult correspondence charts.
elements.test: Which source/tradition/date defines this diagram or correspondence?

elements.identity: Qelippot/kelipot are shell/husk and impurity/capture concepts in Jewish mysticism; the fixed tenfold Dark Tree is a later Western occult system.
elements.function: Models concealment/capture/impurity and, in later occultism, adversarial counterparts to sefirotic structure.
elements.topology: Historical layers differ; no single timeless list.
distinctions: Jewish qelippot != one modern demon chart
named demon rulers vary by source
elements.failure_mode: Later occult demon names are retrojected as original Kabbalistic doctrine.
elements.test: Record shell name, spelling, ruler, source, date and tradition separately.

elements.identity: Federated initiatory/fraternal traditions using Craft degrees, lodge governance, working-tool symbolism and various appendant rites/bodies.
elements.function: Institutional/ritual formation through degree ceremonies, fellowship, moral allegory and symbolic architecture.
elements.topology: Three Craft degrees form a base; Royal Arch, Scottish Rite, York Rite and other bodies differ by jurisdiction.
elements.failure_mode: Jurisdictions and bodies are flattened into conspiracy superstructure.
elements.test: Which Grand Lodge/rite/body/jurisdiction and which documented degree/order?

elements.identity: Use of mathematical/geometric forms within religious, architectural, philosophical or esoteric meaning systems.
elements.function: Links exact form with tradition-specific symbolic interpretation.
elements.topology: May include circles, polygons, ratios, axes, grids, mandorlas and construction methods.
elements.failure_mode: Coincidence is treated as proof of secret transmission.
elements.test: Separate formal construction, historical attestation and later interpretation.

elements.identity: Source-facing field specializing pattern, integration, orientation, memory-model and generative potential.
elements.function: Holds source-side processes without claiming that everything above is true/good or that source is one person.
elements.topology: One parent field of the two-field Potato projection; overlaps Manifestation Field to create Door.
distinctions: Source Field != Heaven in every tradition
elements.failure_mode: Upper placement becomes moral caste or all source-side symbols are collapsed together.
elements.test: Is the active function primarily source/orientation/integration/potential rather than embodiment/consequence?

elements.identity: Manifestation-facing field specializing embodiment, actuality, history, constraint and observable consequence.
elements.function: Makes relations concrete in Body, World, work, institutions and lived history.
elements.topology: Second parent field of the two-field Potato projection; overlaps Source Field to create Door.
elements.failure_mode: The whole lower circle is mistaken for Hell, Swamp or moral failure.
elements.test: Is the active function primarily embodiment/actuality/history/consequence?

elements.identity: Boundary layer that preserves differentiated identity while governing legitimate passage, filtering, signaling and repair.
elements.function: Controls permeability without reducing boundary to wall/closure.
elements.topology: Occurs around fields, Rooms, bodies and Door apertures; may host guards, rules, membranes, consent/evidence thresholds.
elements.failure_mode: Boundary becomes sealed capture or unbounded permeability destroys identity.
elements.test: Does the boundary preserve integrity while retaining legitimate passage, correction and return?

elements.identity: Operative present state centered at O in the active Plane.
elements.function: Gathers relevant provenance, embodied current state, relations and available futures into an actionable present.
elements.topology: Located at O for a chosen frame; narrower than Plane and distinct from universal physical simultaneity.
distinctions: Here/Now != proof all time is simultaneous
elements.failure_mode: Past memory or future projection is mistaken for current state.
elements.test: What is actually current here, and what comes from memory or anticipation?

elements.identity: Visible cross-form produced by the Axis plus a chosen lateral line through O inside Plane.
elements.function: Makes vertical and lateral relations visible in one projection.
elements.topology: CrossSign=Axis∪L, with L⊂Plane and O∈L.
elements.failure_mode: Visual resemblance is used to claim historical origin or total semantic identity.
elements.test: Are the projected lines and their meanings declared?

elements.identity: A trajectory intersects the active Plane and may, if Door guards are satisfied, change state/context.
elements.function: Turns geometry into dated/ordered event records and permits recurrence comparison.
elements.topology: Gamma(t*)∈Plane; strong Door crossing additionally requires declared pre/post state and guard conditions.
distinctions: Plane crossing != strong Door by default
elements.failure_mode: Any passage/appearance is declared transformative without a state change.
elements.test: What crossed, when, in which direction/frame, under what guard, and what state changed?

cross_system_relations.rule: Exact overlap geometry supplies a native project interface; Christian mandorla is a historical visual comparator, not its proof.
Both can express vertical integration; Mountain is terrain/gradient, Pyramid constructed layered compression.
Both route across levels; Ladder uses discrete thresholds, Spiral recurrence with displacement.
Tree differentiates one support into many branches; Pyramid compresses many lower units toward fewer upper layers.
Knowledge is upstream; consequence depends on discernment, incentives and action.
Project comparison focuses on capture/enclosure/blocked reintegration; historical identity is not asserted.
Biblical and later Masonic paired pillars provide a threshold-support comparator.
Need prepotency can inform cultivation conditions; it does not define spiritual rank.
Courage 200 can be compared as an internal threshold in Hawkins' model without treating its number as empirical physics.
Square/compasses/ashlar symbolism can illuminate formation and geometry while remaining a distinct institutional tradition.
